[RFCS.7.4] TTL expiry is not recorded as a `FactRetract`. It is an engine
withdrawal and is recorded as a `FactWithdraw` carrying `TTL_EXPIRED`
([RFCS.7a.2]), which a replayer **compares** rather than applies.

Double retraction is prevented by construction rather than by a rule
someone must remember: the replay re-derives the expiry from `ttl_ns`,
and the recorded atom is compared against what it re-derived.

`FactEmit` carries `ttl_ns` ([RFCS.6a.2]), which is what makes the
re-derivation above possible.
